answer: The marble is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the kernel. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the lantern of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, released only after three unrelated confirmations, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
